description: This file defines interfaces, extension methods, and classes for configuring and setting up EventHub streaming components within the Orleans framework, including configurators for silos and cluster clients, as well as options and factory methods related to EventHub streams.

classes.name: SiloEventHubStreamConfigurator
classes.description: Configures EventHub streaming for silos, including options for checkpointers, partition receivers, and cache pressure.

classes.name: ClusterClientEventHubStreamConfigurator
classes.description: Configures EventHub streaming for cluster clients with dependency injection.

methods.name: ConfigureEventHub
methods.description: Extension method to configure EventHub options.

methods.name: UseDataAdapter
methods.description: Extension method to specify a data adapter factory for EventHub streams.

methods.name: ConfigureCheckpointer
methods.description: Configures the checkpointer component for EventHub streams with specified factory and options.

methods.name: ConfigurePartitionReceiver
methods.description: Configures partition receiver options for EventHub streams.

methods.name: ConfigureCachePressuring
methods.description: Configures cache pressure options for EventHub streams.

methods.name: UseAzureTableCheckpointer
methods.description: Sets up an Azure Table checkpointer for EventHub streams.
